prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Interactive Desktop Display Verification Stage: Redesign the waiting screen with a desktop rendering verification stage component to ensure pet visuals load properly before finalizing spawn. (why: 3 users reported pets failing to display on desktop or app failing to open upon launch.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Custom Pet Realtime Render Inspector: Redesign the photo upload and custom pet creation screen with an interactive render inspector preview that flags custom pet rendering errors before certificate issue. (why: 3 emails cited custom pet generation failing or looking distorted, while adoption stage conversion drops to 74.4% with median time 89s.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery Sync Reassurance Hint: Add explicit reassurance hint on sign-in explaining that existing account pets will be restored immediately without losing progress. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen System Compatibility Status Cards: Add real-time desktop environment diagnostic status cards on the waiting screen to inform users during the long 201s median generation phase. (why: Home waiting step has a median time of 201s and a mean time of 2336s, with users reporting desktop pet display issues.)
4: [adoption, hint] Adoption Photo Quality Live Error Diagnostics: Display instant diagnostic feedback and quality tips when photo validation detects potential pet generation failure conditions. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, contributing to adoption stage drop-offs.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Companion Care Commitment Copy: Update adoption certificate body and button copy to emphasize official companion registration perks and lifetime account sync. (why: Adoption step drops to 74.4% conversion and takes median 89s.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Story Welcome Stage Compact Cards Layout: Change the initial story intro screen layout to a compact card view to reduce mean time spent on choose_path (514s mean). (why: Choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s despite 93.4% conversion, indicating significant user idling.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Companion Direct Overlay Launch Flow: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a full-bleed interactive desktop overlay preview that shows exactly where the pet will spawn. (why: Finish step conversion drops heavily to 64.8% with an extreme mean duration of 5815s.)
